docs.summary: Resizes its own [`RectTransform`](#api~Prowl.Vector.RectTransform) to fit its content (its [`ILayoutElement`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.ILayoutElement) sources - e.g. a child [`LayoutGroup`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.LayoutGroup) or a [`LayoutElement`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.LayoutElement)). The canvas applies the fit just before the element computes its rect, so the fitted size drives layout.

docs.summary: Subclasses fill `builder` in canvas-local pixel space.
Writes the fitted size into the RectTransform's [`SizeDelta`](#api~Prowl.Vector.RectTransform~SizeDelta). Called by the canvas during rebuild before this element's rect is computed.
